set.body: Owner explicitly chose same-chat wakeup adapter on 2026-09-26. Outcome: Fray attention resumes or steers existing thread 01a0de00-841c-7e42-a725-6a60a3f6c0e3 through the already-running Codex app server. Scope: isolated Fray branch codex/interactive-wake at /private/tmp/fray-codex-wake; optional Python host adapter and tests/docs. Preserve approval/model/sandbox settings, never create a replacement thread, never acknowledge receipts automatically, deduplicate/recover conservatively, stop without affecting other sessions. Current live probe confirms target active in eyes4s on daemon 0.157.1 over WebSocket Unix socket. No turn mutation yet.
